title: Brief special meeting with one labour relations direction
subtitle: Holocaust Remembrance Day acknowledgement, in-camera session authorization and routine confirmation by-law before the planning meeting.
overview: Council held a short special meeting on January 27, 2025. It opened with a land acknowledgement and a moment of silence marking International Holocaust Remembrance Day and the 80th anniversary of the liberation of Auschwitz-Birkenau.

Council agreed to hold a closed session on an employee relations matter {{vote:m1}}. After it reconvened, Council directed staff to proceed in line with the direction received through a Development Services Department report on a labour relations matter {{vote:m2}}. The minutes do not publicly report the content of that direction, so the effect on residents is not described.
Council also gave third reading to the confirming by-law, 2025-016. The meeting adjourned at 6:01 p.m. so the planning meeting could begin, chaired by Chair Singh.

decisions.detail: Council directed staff to proceed in accordance with the direction received through Development Services report DSD-2024-497, which was considered in closed session.

debate: The transcript records no debate on the labour relations motion beyond the chair asking for discussion before the vote.
The Mayor's remarks called for an end to anti-Semitic behaviour and for a society free of racism, hatred and violence.
